name: image-gen-mcp
description: Game asset MCP: generate images via qweapi (gpt-image-2, supports reference-image editing), recognize images via vision model (gpt-5.6-sol), plus local post-processing (crop/resize/convert/sprite-sheet slicing).

description_i18n.en: Game asset MCP: generate images via qweapi (gpt-image-2, supports reference-image editing), recognize images via vision model (gpt-5.6-sol), plus local post-processing (crop/resize/convert/sprite-sheet slicing).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 游戏开发专属素材 MCP：qweapi 生图（gpt-image-2，支持参考图编辑）、视觉识图（gpt-5.6-sol，为无视觉模型补充眼睛）、本地后处理（裁剪/缩放/转换/精灵图切帧）。

api_key.title: qweapi API Key
api_key.description: qweapi.com API key. Leave empty to use the .env file in the plugin root.

vision_model.title: Vision model
vision_model.description: Vision model id used by describe_image (default: gpt-5.6-sol).
